scope: Editing over a contiguous value (dom/otp.ts), the resolver, and the web component in happy-dom: anatomy, ARIA, the tab stop, typing, rejection, paste distribution, completion, deletes, arrows, focus redirect, validation types, normalizeValue, mask, validity, read-only, disabled, auto-submit, reset, authored cells and separators, events; the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), its markup parity with the web component and the compound parts. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: the resolver; validation types, insert and distribution, deletes, focus limit, keys; anatomy, ARIA, tab stop, typing and rejection, paste, complete, Backspace / Delete / arrows / Home / End, focus redirect, mask, normalizeValue, required and incomplete validity, read-only, disabled, auto-submit, reset, authored cells and separators

SSR markup against the web component (host and cell data-*, ARIA, classes, tab stop, input mode, autocomplete, characters), the hidden form input, mask, compound parts against the preset, separators, render and className functions, parts outside the Root

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02, Chromium): apps/studio/geometry-check.html checks the cell width and height (8u), padding (u − B), radius, font and line height, the 1u gap, the separator's 2u × 0.5u size, its radius and its 1u gaps, and the row height at every size × B 0 and 1 ("fails": []). Growth: at u = 2 cells are 16px squares; in a 100px container the six 36px cells keep their size (the row does not shrink them; the container clips or scrolls). RTL: the cells mirror (the first on the right) and Arrow Left moves to the next cell. Focus: the 2px ring is an outline on the focused cell, its 36px box unchanged. Real Chromium input: a press on cell 3 of an empty field lands on cell 1; typing 1a2 gives 12 (a refused); Backspace on the empty cell clears the one before; pasting 98-76 from cell 2 gives 1987, complete. Screenshots: the Entry family (#/components?family=entry), light and dark, ladder 3, 4, 4.5 (theme) and 6.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React OTPField with ui-otp-field at five sizes, and the composed parts with the preset ("fails": []).
Platform one-time-code autofill needs a native input: only the React renderer gets it (the web component's cells are contenteditables).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
